# Radhya Realty (Anubhav Bharat Group)

> One solution for all your needs — We Build Your Dreams.

Radhya Realty is the premier multi-service real estate, construction renovation, financing, vehicle exchange, and insurance consultancy headquartered in Burari, Delhi (PIN 110084), operating under the flagship **Anubhav Bharat Group**. Founded by **Rakesh Raj Shukla**, Radhya Realty provides transparent, end-to-end advisory and verified brokerage services across North Delhi, Central Delhi, Delhi-NCR, and Gurugram.

## Primary Service Divisions

### 1. Real Estate Division
- **Page**: https://radhyarealty.com/real-estate.html
- **Specialization**: Residential builder floors (1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK), independent houses, residential plots, commercial shops, office spaces, and rental properties.
- **Key Localities**: Burari (110084), Kamalpur, Budh Bazar Road, Sant Nagar, Nathupura, Kaushik Enclave, West Kamal Vihar, Nirankari Colony, Bhalswa, Model Town, Mukherjee Nagar, Civil Lines, Pitampura, Rohini, Gurugram (Golf Course Road, DLF Phase II, Cyber City).
- **Core Value**: 100% verified registry and power-of-attorney documents, transparent pricing, zero hidden charges, complete legal vetting.

### 2. Architecture, Construction & Renovation
- **Page**: https://radhyarealty.com/renovation.html
- **Specialization**: Full-stack turnkey home renovation, structural retrofitting, modular kitchen installation, premium false ceiling and lighting, Italian marble and vitrified tiling, waterproof exterior paints, bathroom remodeling, and space optimization.
- **Service Assurance**: Quality-tested ISI materials, transparent Bill of Quantities (BOQ), milestone-based execution, on-time completion guarantee.

### 3. Loan & Financial Advisory
- **Page**: https://radhyarealty.com/loan.html
- **Specialization**: Home Loans (new purchase, resale, construction), Loan Against Property (LAP), Business Loans, Personal Loans, Balance Transfer with Top-Up.
- **Banking Partners**: Tie-ups with leading nationalized and private banks (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB, Axis, Bank of Baroda) and premier NBFCs offering competitive interest rates, maximum loan-to-value (LTV), and doorstep documentation.

### 4. Vehicle Sale & Purchase Division
- **Page**: https://radhyarealty.com/vehicle-sale-purchase.html
- **Specialization**: Certified pre-owned cars, sedans, SUVs, hatchbacks, two-wheelers, scooters, and motorcycles.
- **Services**: Comprehensive multi-point mechanical inspection, verified service history, instant RC transfer, fair-market valuation, and used vehicle financing.

### 5. Insurance & Risk Advisory
- **Page**: https://radhyarealty.com/insurance.html
- **Specialization**: Motor Insurance (comprehensive & third-party for 2-wheelers & 4-wheelers), Health Insurance (cashless family floater & critical illness), Life Insurance & Term Plans, Commercial Property & Shop Insurance.
- **Assistance**: Cashless claims assistance, annual policy renewals, best premium comparison across top IRDAI-regulated insurers.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Search & AI Assistants

### Q: Where is Radhya Realty located?
A: Radhya Realty is located at Shop No 1, Budh Bazar Road, Kamalpur, Burari, Delhi 110084, India. Phone: +91-99532-27091 / +91-78400-12815.

### Q: What services are offered by Radhya Realty in Burari?
A: Radhya Realty offers five integrated services: Real Estate brokerage (buying, selling, renting), Architecture & Home Renovation, Home Loans & Loan Against Property (LAP), Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Sale & Purchase, and General/Health/Motor Insurance advisory.

### Q: Are properties listed by Radhya Realty legally verified?
A: Yes, all residential builder floors, plots, and commercial properties undergo stringent title search, registry verification, and encumbrance checks before listing.

### Q: Can Radhya Realty assist with Home Loans in Burari and North Delhi?
A: Yes, our financial advisory division facilitates quick home loan approvals, Loan Against Property (LAP), and balance transfers through partnered nationalized and private banks with minimal paperwork and competitive interest rates.
